weather.title: Weather in your relationships
weather.body: The Weather Station helps you feel the temperature of your connections—written just for you, no explanations needed.

record.title: Just jot it down
record.body: Text or voice works. Write what comes to mind—no need to be perfect or say it all at once.

garden.title: Your inner garden grows
garden.body: Every entry adds a little green. Here you'll see your gentle growth over time.

firstEntry.hint: First time? Jot down how you feel right now—only you can see this.
firstEntry.placeholder: How's the weather in your relationships today? Write what's on your mind…
